Advanced Shifting Analytics (Gear Choice vs. Terrain)
Analyzes drivetrain efficiency by mapping your gear selection (ratios) against the terrain profile. Highlights Cross-Chaining (Big front ring to largest rear cogs, or small front ring to smallest rear cogs) which increases mechanical friction, chain noise, and drivetrain wear.

Neuromuscular vs. Aerobic Load (Quadrant Analysis)
This chart plots Average Effective Pedal Force (AEPF) in Newtons against Circumferential Pedal Velocity (CPV) in m/s. The dashed crosshairs indicate your mean force and velocity, dividing the plot into four quadrants: QI (High Force / High Velocity - Sprinting), QII (High Force / Low Velocity - Climbing/Mashing), QIII (Low Force / Low Velocity - Recovery), and QIV (Low Force / High Velocity - Spinning), showing how your muscle recruitment and aerobic contribution were balanced during active pedaling.

FTP History & Estimation
